all_findings.candidate_fix: Add a portfolio-level drawdown circuit breaker: when running DD exceeds 10% within 5 trading days, force trim each position by 50% at next close. Re-entry permitted only after equity recovers to within 5% of prior peak. Implementation point: extend tools/run_broker_position_risk_replay.py or wire into operating_main/concentrated_target_book builder.
all_findings.evidence: MDD window 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-18 (-26.02% drawdown, equity loss $32,838) had only 14 round-trip exits totaling $-2,371 P&L. The drawdown is therefore dominated by unrealized loss on still-held positions (realized share 7.2%).

all_findings.candidate_fix: Reduce capacity_for_regime['neutral'] in the operating book builder by 20-30%, or tighten entry quality threshold (e.g. raise min_score_quantile) for neutral signal dates. Re-measure F2 share on next broker-ledger replay.
